Select frames in Figma

Keeps native vectors and text where supported. Frames that need rasterization use the selected fallback quality.

Applies to raster pages and vector fallbacks. PNG keeps transparency and sharp text.

Preserves the Figma file’s exported color profile.

Choose the CMYK ICC profile supplied by your printer (.icc or .icm, up to 16 MiB).

CMYK beta creates raster pages on a white background and keeps links clickable. Maximum 8 million pixels per page; enable Fit oversized raster pages to lower resolution when needed. This is not a PDF/X export.

When enabled, lowers resolution only for pages above the raster size limits. PDF page dimensions stay unchanged.

Save each part before continuing. Keep every PDF together with its original filename. Links between parts require a compatible desktop PDF viewer. The export pauses for up to 15 minutes between parts.

Each PDF has a 128 MiB retained-data allowance. Lower resolution or smaller parts can help large exports. For RGB exports, JPEG can help photo-heavy pages. Processing also needs memory beyond the PDF size.
